exposure: Preimplantation genetic testing (PGT) involving trophectoderm (TE) biopsy
cohort: The cohort consisted of 2092 patients undergoing frozen single blastocyst transfer cycles between January 2012 and December 2017.
finding: Preimplantation genetic testing (PGT) was associated with higher live birth rates and lower miscarriage rates, without increasing the risk of pregnancy complications or negatively impacting early motor development in infants.
